capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction legacy address enrichment using completion days 121-180 and uniqueness days 0-180
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data was run across all 2,712 priced, addressless sold Savills legacy appearances in 2010, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018. 29 matches were retained only where the exact hammer price, completion 121-180 days after auction, cumulative uniqueness across days 0-180, exact locality or postcode district, tenure and property class aligned to one compatible transaction used by no other lot. All no-result, ambiguous, class-conflicting, shared-transaction and already-used-address candidates remain unchanged. Original Savills/PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
